compiled_state.title: [CI llm-review]: DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE never set to 2 in CI -> defense suppression and mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh are non-functional
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 043db922dc (HEAD at session close)
* **workflow:** .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml and related CI jobs

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

On CI re-review (cycle ≥ 2), DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE should be set to 2+ so runner.py calls _fetch_pr_defenses() to suppress already-defended findings. The mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh CI job should post DEFENSE_RECORD comments from reviewer-findings.json to the PR.

#### Actual Behavior

Three root causes discovered during epic ac1b-5e35 PR #96 CI failures:
1. sprint-story-review.yml never sets DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var, so it always defaults to 1 in runner.py (line: `cycle_number = int(os.environ.get("DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE", "1"))`). Defense suppression is never active across retry runs.
2. mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh CI job reads from stdin with nothing piped — it is a no-op in CI. Manually posting DEFENSE_RECORD comments to the PR has no effect because the CI job never reads them.
3. Strategy E cluster-split (triggers at 400 LOC / 15 files) causes cross-cluster false positives: the CLAUDE.md cluster reviewer cannot see skills/ cluster to verify a skill file exists; the tests/ cluster reviewer cannot see the SKILL.md it tests.

Result: The defense mechanism is architecturally non-functional in CI. Each re-review run behaves as a fresh cycle 1 review with no memory of previous defenses, producing non-deterministic findings. PR #96 required 3+ CI runs and ultimately user-forced merge.

### 3. Action History

- Three CI llm-review runs on PR #96 (epic ac1b-5e35), each producing different blocking findings
- Attempted adding REVIEW-DEFENSE comments to source files — backfired (drew more attention)
- Attempted posting DEFENSE_RECORD comments to PR manually — had no effect (CI job is no-op)
- Escalated to user; user force-merged PR externally

comments.body: Cluster investigation complete. Root causes: RC-A (infra, hits this + d565-805a/a2e9-4227 only): DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE never exported in any .github/workflows/*.yml (runner.py:789 defaults to 1; suppression branches at runner.py:843/894/922 dead in CI) AND mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh invoked at ci.yml:288 with no stdin producer (script reads DEFENSE_RECORD from stdin per review-github-defense-store.sh:91-102). RC-B (reviewer prompt, hits ee3a-43fc/b2ef-cd72/9e84-2b78 only): Verify-Before-Assert rules exist in reviewer-base.md:66-82 and code-reviewer-light.md:75-91 but LLM disregards them; needs structured verification_evidence field + post-LLM validator + rubric anchors. Both RCs are independent but compound. Complexity: COMPLEX (8+ files / 3 subsystems / 2 RCs). Per fix-bug Phase D Step 2 — escalating to epic via /dso:brainstorm. Do NOT proceed to RED test / implementation in this session. Recommended fix bundle ships RC-A (F1+F2+F3) before RC-B (F4+F5+F6).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: RC-A fix opened as PR #103 https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/103 (commit 97ffc0d914 on branch fix/rc-a-defense-pipeline-20260512-160059). Adds DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE export to ci.yml and sprint-story-review.yml + stdin producer for mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh (review-defense-store.sh new `list` subcommand) + integration test test-ci-defense-pipeline.sh. RED-before-fix confirmed; GREEN after. Once merged, this ticket should close (RC-A fully addressed).
